event_description: Executed machine instructions, not CPU cycles or wall-clock shares

method.aggregation: Sum exclusive instruction records across source locations by function name; exclude inclusive call-cost records. Function sums were checked against the Callgrind summary total. Call counts sum incoming calls= records.

symbol_aliases.relar_str_retain: Shared machine-code address with relar_list_retain; this workload calls that entry for list retains.

method.limitations: Hardware perf counters are disabled on this devbox (perf_event_paranoid=4). Instruction profiles are separate from uninstrumented timing runs. Generated Python functions may be inlined into callers.

ownership-and-index-inlining.build_description: Exploratory intermediate build: borrowed locals/unchanged parameters plus #[inline] index; before wrapping normalization and inline floor/mod. See corresponding ablation record for hashes.

trace_path_normalization: Environment-specific source/object prefixes are replaced by /relar/, /cargo-registry/, and /valgrind/. Instruction counts, call records, symbols, and all other trace content are unchanged. Trace hashes identify the published path-normalized files; original_uncompressed_trace_sha256 identifies the preserved local capture.
